list.snippet: Zapdos ex (#145/165): A Double Rare card featuring 200 HP and the Multishot Lightning attack.
Zapdos ex (#202/165): A highly sought-after Special Illustration Rare featuring vibrant artwork by Shiburingaru, valued around $82.
Collection Box MSRP: Originally priced around $21.99.

Single Cards: The standard double rare (#145) sells for about $2.00, while the special illustration rare (#202) trades higher depending on the grade and condition. Opinions on current third-party markups for the sealed collection box vary on platforms like Reddit, where users note that prices often exceed original retail due to ongoing demand.
